result.reason: The clause does not reach either playbook position. Although it is mutual, limited to directly involved personnel, includes solicitation carve-outs, and contains no no-hire, the 12-month restriction runs from the end of the Agreement rather than from the end of each employee’s involvement. It also adds contact and six-month departed-employee conditions not required by the fallback, so the revision is not minimal. Unrelated commercial intent is generally preserved, but “ended at least six (6) months prior” lacks a clear reference point.
